svg.desc: Measure image-pixel intensity along the indicated x axis. Adobe Photoshop histogram tool. Pixel sampling is not true optical spatial resolution. No numerical PL intensities are digitized. Conceptual source operation. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and particle shape are unassigned.
